title: Discovery of novel direct small-molecule inhibitors targeting HIF-2alpha using structure-based virtual screening, molecular dynamics simulation, and MM-GBSA calculations.
authors: Yazdani, Behnaz; Sirous, Hajar; Enguita, Francisco J; Brogi, Simone; Wing, Peter A C; Fassihi, Afshin
one_liner_zh: 该文用虚拟筛选、MD和MM-GBSA发现HIF-2α小分子抑制剂，对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移但非本课题核心。
abstract: Hypoxia-inducible factors (HIFs) are the main regulatory factors implicated in the adaptation of cancer cells to hypoxic stress, which has provoked much interest as an attractive target for the design of promising chemotherapeutic agents. Since indirect HIF inhibitors (HIFIs) lead to the occurrence of various side effects, the need of the hour is to develop direct HIFIs, physically interacting with important functional domains within the HIF protein structure. Accordingly, in the present study, it was attempted to develop an exhaustive structure-based virtual screening (VS) process coupled with molecular docking, molecular dynamic (MD) simulation, and MM-GBSA calculations for the identification of novel direct inhibitors against the HIF-2alpha subunit. For this purpose, a focused library of over 200,000 compounds from the NCI database was used for VS against the PAS-B domain of the target protein, HIF-2alpha. This domain was suggested to be a possible ligand-binding site, which is characterized by a large internal hydrophobic cavity, unique to the HIF-2alpha subunit. The top-ranked compounds, NSC106416, NSC217021, NSC217026, NSC215639, and NSC277811 with the best docking scores were taken up for the subsequent in silico ADME properties and PAINS filtration. The selected drug-like hits were employed for carrying out MD simulation which was followed by MM-GBSA calculations to retrieve the candidates showing the highest in silico binding affinity towards the PAS-B domain of HIF-2alpha. The analysis of results indicated that all molecules, except the NSC277811, fulfilled necessary drug-likeness properties. Four selected drug-like candidates, NSC106416, NSC217021, NSC217026, and NSC215639 were found to expose the stability profiles within the cavity located inside the PAS-B domain of HIF-2alpha over simulation time. Finally, the results of the MM-GBSA rescoring method were indicative of the highest binding affinity of NSC217026 for the binding site of the HIF-2alpha PAS-B domain among selected final hits. Consequently, the hit NSC217026 could serve as a promising scaffold for further optimization toward the design of direct HIF-2alpha inhibitors for cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子（HIFs）是参与癌细胞适应低氧应激的主要调控因子，因其作为设计有前景的化疗药物的吸引性靶点而备受关注。由于间接HIF抑制剂（HIFIs）会导致各种副作用的发生，当前迫切需要开发直接HIFIs，即与HIF蛋白结构内重要功能域发生物理相互作用的抑制剂。因此，在本研究中，尝试开发一种详尽的基于结构的虚拟筛选（VS）流程，结合分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟和MM-GBSA计算，以识别针对HIF-2α亚基的新型直接抑制剂。为此，使用来自NCI数据库的超过20万种化合物的聚焦库，针对目标蛋白HIF-2α的PAS-B结构域进行虚拟筛选。该结构域被认为是可能的配体结合位点，其特征是内部存在一个大的疏水腔，这是HIF-2α亚基所特有的。排名靠前的化合物NSC106416、NSC217021、NSC217026、NSC215639和NSC277811，因其最佳对接分数而被用于后续的计算机模拟ADME性质和PAINS过滤。选定的类药命中化合物用于进行MD模拟，随后进行MM-GBSA计算，以筛选出对HIF-2α的PAS-B结构域具有最高计算机模拟结合亲和力的候选物。结果分析表明，除NSC277811外，所有分子均满足必要的类药性特征。四个选定的类药候选物NSC106416、NSC217021、NSC217026和NSC215639在模拟时间内，在HIF-2α的PAS-B结构域内部的腔中表现出稳定性特征。最后，MM-GBSA重新打分方法的结果表明，在选定的最终命中化合物中，NSC217026对HIF-2α PAS-B结构域结合位点具有最高的结合亲和力。因此，命中化合物NSC217026可作为进一步优化以设计用于癌症治疗的直接HIF-2α抑制剂的有前景骨架。
